decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1) The continued use of a single-family house as two self contained flats, would result in the loss of a family house for which there is an identified need in the Borough. The proposal would not provide unsatisfactory living accommodation for future residents, contrary to Council Supplementary Planning Guidance.  For these reasons, the proposal is contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines).

2) The conversion of an existing single family house to form two flats, when taking into account the self contained residential unit within the detached outbuilding, would be harmful to neighbours' living conditions, through increased noise and disturbance. Contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

3) The proposal provides insufficient on-site parking, contrary to Council car parking standards, which would generate additional on street parking harmful to the free flow and safety of traffic and pedestrians on the adjoining highway in light of highway conditions in the vicinity.
Condition : 2 - Informative

The evidence at the site, such as the presence of a W.C, two bedrooms and kitchen facilities within the outbuilding, indicate that the detached outbuilding is being used as a self contained residential unit. It represents unacceptable backland development and creates sub standard residential accommodation. It would harm the character of the area as well as neighbours' living conditions through loss of outlook and increased noise and disturbance, contrary to Unitary Development Plan policies H.6.3 and H.4.1. The structure would also not constitute permitted development.
description: Continued use of house as two self contained flats.
